question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

One who is new to some trade or profession
solution:
The correct answer is '**Novice**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate word for the given group of words is '**Novice**'.
 
• **Novice**: a person who is new and without experience in a certain job, situation, etc. (किसी विशेष काम, परिसि्‍थति आदि के लिए नया और अनुभवहीन व्यक्ति; नौसिखिया)
 
 
• *Example: I'm just a **novice** at making videos.*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *Novice.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of other words:
 
 
• **Philistine**: a person who does not like, understand or enjoy the beauty of art, literature, music, etc. (कला, साहित्य, संगीत आदि के सौंदर्य को न समझनेवाला; संस्कारशून्य व्यक्ति; अशिक्षित मनुष्य)
 
• **Martyr**: a person who is killed because of what he/she believes. (अपने विश्‍वासों के कारण आत्‍म-बलिदान करने वाला व्यक्ति; शहीद, बलिदानी)
 
• **Omnipresent**: present everywhere at the same time. (सभी जगह मौजूद; सर्वव्यापी)
